First public release: a Cortex-M33 smartwatch kernel derived from orbit-os, and the schematic of an nRF54L15 watch board.

## Highlights
- Tickless idle slaved to a low-power counter with a drift-free tick grid; idle / tickless / deep / off power states
- Sharp memory-LCD partial refresh: 7x fewer SPI bytes than full refresh with the seconds shown (host benchmark)
- Integer step counter and PPG heart rate (0.05 to 1.7 bpm MAE on 8 BIDMC fingertip PPG excerpts)
- Runs for an hour of virtual time under `qemu-system-arm -M mps2-an505` in CI, with a virtual panel image
- SKiDL schematic: nRF54L15, nPM1300, BMI270, MAX30101, LS013B7DH05, with netlist, BOM, ERC and design checks

## Downloads
- `orbit-watch-an505.elf`: firmware for QEMU (see the README quickstart)
- `orbit-watch-nrf54l15.elf` / `orbit-watch-nrf54l15.bin`: firmware for the rev A board (builds; not yet run on silicon)
- `orbit-watch-hardware.zip`: KiCad netlist, BOM, ERC and design-check reports, pin-out
- `orbit-watch-results.zip`: emulated-run statistics, panel images, benchmark JSON and the power model

## Not yet verified
These need the physical board and are tracked in the README's Status table:
- PCB layout, routing and 3D renders (placement notes and a layout checklist are in docs/hardware.md)
- First boot of the nRF54L15 firmware, sensor drivers and the GRTC/VCOM setup
- Measured sleep current and battery life (only a datasheet-based model exists)
- On-wrist photo
